sql: SELECT * FROM ((SELECT 1 AS g, p.captured_at::text AS t, p.market_ticker AS c2, coalesce(p.side,'-') AS c3, p.quantity::text AS c4, coalesce(p.quantity_fp::text,'-') AS c5, p.avg_price::text AS c6, coalesce(p.realized_pnl::text,'-') AS c7, coalesce(p.market_exposure::text,'-') AS c8 FROM positions p WHERE p.market_ticker LIKE 'KXUSLEI-26SEP18%' ORDER BY p.captured_at DESC LIMIT 8) UNION ALL (SELECT 2 AS g, coalesce(f.filled_at::text,'-'), f.market_ticker, coalesce(f.side,'-'), coalesce(f.action,'-'), f.price::text, f.quantity::text, coalesce(f.fee::text,'-'), coalesce(f.kalshi_order_id,'-') FROM fills f WHERE f.market_ticker LIKE 'KXUSLEI-26SEP18%' OR f.market_ticker LIKE 'KXTRUMPAPPROVE-26SEP18%' OR f.market_ticker LIKE 'KXBIGGESTQUAKE-17SEP26%' ORDER BY f.filled_at DESC LIMIT 10) UNION ALL (SELECT 3 AS g, p2.captured_at::text, p2.market_ticker, coalesce(p2.side,'-'), p2.quantity::text, '-', p2.avg_price::text, coalesce(p2.realized_pnl::text,'-'), coalesce(p2.market_exposure::text,'-') FROM positions p2 WHERE p2.market_ticker LIKE 'KXTRUMPAPPROVE-26SEP18%' ORDER BY p2.captured_at DESC LIMIT 4)) u ORDER BY g, t DESC
